paragraphs: I am a Data Scientist who develops and deploys machine learning and statistical models, working from exploratory analysis and feature engineering through validation, deployment and monitoring.

At Synchrony I build predictive models for customer behavior, risk, credit, fraud and retention across datasets of 300K+ records, supporting 8+ business use cases across financial and customer analytics.

My strongest results come from careful modeling: about 15% better performance on selected models through hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation and error analysis, and 18% better analytical data quality through structured preprocessing and validation.

Before Synchrony, I spent two and a half years at Cybage Software building supervised and unsupervised models, and I hold an M.S. in Applied Statistics and Data Science from the University of Texas at Arlington.
